purpose: Three fixed past memories before Kkamang arrives; no dialogue or UI baked into the images.

images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: finished full-bleed game memory illustration, image ONE of three, landscape 16:9, ideally 1536x864 or 2048x1152. ONE SINGLE SCENE, no collage.
Create a polished hand-painted storybook illustration with soft gouache and watercolor-paper texture, gently rounded shapes, expressive believable cats, restrained warm amber and muted mauve brown colors, beautifully composed environmental storytelling. Cozy old manor communal living room in the past. No text, lettering, captions, labels, panels, frames, logos, watermark, UI.
Scene: a grandmother patiently welcomes a rain-soaked white kitten, BEFORE a black cat ever arrives. Exactly ONE cat in this picture: Bosong, a small white fluffy kitten with natural upright ears and damp fur. No black cat, no other cats, no ghosts.
Composition must clearly arrange these visible story objects for a game that reveals regions gradually:
Far LEFT (x 3-18%): slightly open arched wooden entrance door, rain and cool blue night outside. A trail of small wet cat pawprints travels from that doorway diagonally across the floor towards the kitten.
Back wall left of center (x 26-44%, y 12-45%): a broad window with tied-back curtains and rain outside. This window, the stone fireplace and grandma's upholstered chair will be identical architectural landmarks in all three pictures.
Center foreground (x 43-55%, y 65-87%): a large dry cream towel on the rug, catching warm firelight. The small white kitten cautiously stands low on it with front paws visible, damp fur, head looking toward grandma, tentative but starting to feel safe. Her small paws reach slightly forward onto the towel. Not being hugged or held.
RIGHT of center (x 56-71%, y 18-60%): lit old stone fireplace with a small circular protective motif carved above its opening, and a small simple wall clock above the mantel.
Beside it on the RIGHT (x 73-85%, y 38-82%): a grandmother seated in a mauve upholstered wooden chair, grey hair in a low bun, sage cardigan, muted rose skirt, kind lined face, slight sideways posture to leave room for the kitten. Her open relaxed hand is lowered beside the chair around x 70%, y 66%, withdrawn after placing the towel. She patiently waits for the kitten to approach. No reaching to grab it.
Low little table in the middle distance (x 47-54%, y 51-62%): a closed illustrated garden guide with a green garden-path drawing on its cover (no readable text). A tiny wooden garden-direction sign with a simple leaf/path pictogram stands near it, no letters.
Leave enough floor around the towel and kitten to separate the towel, the paws, and the full face/body into later reveal regions. A warm orange light path leads the eye from the cold blue entrance and wet pawprints to the towel and patient hand.
A far-right side of the same room can quietly suggest a dark wooden upright piano and garden door; they must remain secondary and unoccupied. No additional person. The emotional center is waiting and safety, not picking up or embracing the kitten.
The entire image is a single fixed moment, no motion sequence. Richly finished picture-book art, not a simple vector placeholder, not photorealistic, not anime, no lettering anywhere.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: finished game memory illustration TWO of three, landscape 16:9, full bleed, no border, no UI or text.
Input image 1 is an architectural, character and rendering-style REFERENCE for the same manor living room at a later time. Generate a NEW finished single illustration, not a collage. Match that image's warm detailed storybook-painted surfaces, soft expressive animals, grandmother identity, sage cardigan/rose skirt, stone fireplace, mauve upholstered chair, left entrance, curtained main window, wooden floor and rug. Same wide eye-level camera and recognizable room layout. No captions, lettering, logos, watermarks.
This is a peaceful SUNLIT AFTERNOON in the past, before the black protagonist cat ever arrived. Exactly THREE cats: a now-grown fluffy WHITE Bosong, a warm GINGER tabby Ipari, and a soft lavender-GREY Dore with natural cat anatomy and upright ears. NO BLACK CAT. No other animals, ghosts or supernatural effects.
One continuous communal living room, not separate rooms. Keep the broad window LEFT of center, stone fireplace RIGHT of center, same chair just to its right, and upright wooden piano at the far RIGHT.
LEFT foreground/side (about x 20-35%, y 55-80%): Bosong is lying relaxed with front paws tucked under on the rug, beneath a LOW wall scarf hook holding a soft muted rose scarf. The scarf and Bosong must be one readable small group.
WINDOW group (x 30-44%, y 28-55%): Ipari the ginger tabby is stretched luxuriously on the broad low sunny window seat next to a green potted plant and small seed pouch. Leaf shadows fall on the cat. The ginger cat's entire face and body are clearly visible, physically separated from the white cat and piano.
PIANO group far RIGHT (x 78-98%, y 34-84%): the SAME grey-haired grandmother is now seated at the upright piano playing, with hands on the keyboard; her mauve armchair stays visibly empty between piano and fireplace. Dore the lavender-grey cat is standing beside her on the piano stool or bench, playfully putting ONE front paw gently on the keys and looking toward her. This cat and the grandmother must be clearly visible together, not obscured behind furniture. Show open sheet music on piano (musical notes only, no words).
CENTER foreground (x 45-60%, y 63-84%): a LOW wooden tea table holds grandmother's ONE teacup resting on a ceramic SAUCER. Clearly distinguish the cup handle and saucer underneath. These belong to the grandmother, no cat drinking tea and no pet food bowls. Warm afternoon sunshine and the rug visually connect all three cats' places.
The left entrance is shut now, weather outside the main window clear, warm long golden afternoon rays. Fireplace has a small gentle fire. Small clock above the mantel, same simple leaf protective carving over fireplace. No kitten on a towel in the center; Bosong is relaxed at her own left place now. Each cat enjoys a separate safe favorite place in this SAME home. Tender lived-in candid moment, not a posed group portrait. Exactly 3 cats and 1 grandmother. Preserve recognizable architectural continuity with the reference, a full fixed original image for gradual reveal.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: finished game memory illustration THREE of three, landscape 16:9, full bleed, no borders, no UI, no words or captions.
Input image 1 is an architectural and style REFERENCE of the same manor living room. Generate a NEW single-scene finished image, not a collage. Preserve this house's same camera, wooden entrance on left, broad curtained window left of center, stone fireplace right of center with leaf protection medallion and wall clock above, mauve grandmother armchair to the right, dark upright piano far right, same rug. Same beautifully detailed painted storybook style, now cool storm-blue and muted mauve with tiny recognizable warm orange lights.
This is a tragic but gentle STORMY NIGHT IN THE PAST, never a happy ending or dawn. No black protagonist cat. Exactly THREE cats total: fluffy WHITE Bosong, warm GINGER tabby Ipari, and soft lavender-GREY Dore with upright ears. NO grandmother present. Her SAME armchair near the fireplace is EMPTY with her rose shawl draped over its back. No people, no silhouettes in doorway, no extra animals.
WINDOW (x 26-46%, y 8-48%): tied-back curtains with clearly visible curtain cord; fierce diagonal rain, wind-blown branches and cold blue night through the glass. No sun.
CENTER LOWER foreground (x 36-66%, y 63-89%): the three cats huddle shoulder to shoulder, white on LEFT, ginger in CENTER, lavender-grey on RIGHT, under ONE shared muted-lavender blanket. Their faces are visible just above its upper edge, sad and clinging to each other. Some furred paws and tails are visible beneath/alongside the blanket, so blanket and bodies can be revealed before faces. All three faces and the supernatural transformations are concentrated in the upper half of this single huddled group, around x 35-68%, y 56-72%.
Crucial transformation: each cat has ONE SINGLE CONTINUOUS BODY. Part of the SAME shoulder, flank or tail becomes translucent, showing the background faintly through it, with a soft tapering ghostlike outer contour still ATTACHED to that same body's outline. Retain feline face and body identity. DO NOT draw a second ghost above, beside, behind, or emerging from a cat; no floating spirit faces. Three creatures total, not six. Tiny warm amber-orange round/droplet fragments detach directly from those translucent edges and rise gently just around the cats' heads/shoulders. Their shapes are simple round golden heat motes with a tiny cream glint, like collectible warmth. Visually show warmth leaving these same cats, not candle sparks or a spell being cast.
FIREPLACE (x 53-72%, y 19-62%): fire nearly extinguished to a few red embers. The same small leaf protective medallion above it is CRACKED with a faint cold glow through the cracks, no written runes. Keep this fireplace and the stopped clock clearly separate from the cats' faces/heat motes so these objects can be revealed earlier.
MUSIC: a simple freestanding music rest near the LEFT SIDE of the fireplace holds the final page of a lullaby, a page of staff lines and musical notes, no words, no magic symbols, not a spellbook. The wall clock above fireplace is visibly still, hands fixed.
DOOR: the arched wooden doorway at the far LEFT stands slightly ajar with a prominent old brass HANDLE, cold wind and storm outside; it suggests the garden passage, NOT dawn light. Leave its handle and threshold separate from window/empty chair.
The original remains a dark rainy past memory forever. Emotion is loneliness, lost warmth, staying together. It must immediately read as three familiar cats themselves turning ghostlike, and why their home became cold. No gravestones, gore, violence, angels, ghost duplicates, black cat, sunshine, reunion scene, text or explanatory caption.
images.final_edit_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the already finished third memory game illustration.
Change ONLY the treatment of the three cats' body edges and escaping golden warmth. Preserve this exact composition, camera, architecture, furniture positions, rainy dark night, empty grandma chair with shawl, cracked fireplace protection medallion, embers, stopped clock, final lullaby sheet, left door/handle, blanket shape, cat identities/colors/poses and face locations. Exactly three cats, white LEFT, ginger CENTER, grey RIGHT, no person, no black cat.
This picture must be revealed in a game: lower bodies and tails are visible before the faces and magical transformation. Make all the cats' LOWER protruding paws, lower fur, and tails completely SOLID, OPAQUE, non-glowing natural fur. Specifically the white lower paw/fur patch below the left cat near the front-left blanket edge, the white tail extending along the left blanket edge, and grey lower paw/tail along the right/front blanket edge: REMOVE every orange dot, golden glitter, glowing reflection, luminous fleck and translucent/smoky wisp from these lower areas. Retain clearly readable opaque white/ginger/grey paws and solid curled tails peeking from under ONE shared lavender blanket. No gold flecks on the blanket or anywhere below the cats' chin/paw line.
Instead, confine ALL detached tiny amber-orange warmth motes and ALL supernatural translucent edges to the cats' HEAD-AND-UPPER-SHOULDER BAND, above the front paws. On each of the SAME three cats, one small visible UPPER shoulder/ear/flank edge gradually loses opacity into a soft ghostlike pale blue outline, attached to that same body and showing a little of the background through it. The warm orange fragments detach directly from these UPPER fading fur edges and float just above/around the heads. It should be unmistakable that these three cats' own single bodies are losing warmth and turning ghostlike, not separate spirits leaving them. No detached ghost figures, no extra faces, no duplicate bodies. Faces stay in the EXACT same positions and preserve sad gentle expressions.
Warmth particles should remain simple tiny orange-gold round or teardrop shapes with cream glints, rather than broad magical ribbons. Concentrate the fading edges and particles in the central upper band, roughly x 38-75% and y 49-70% of the image. Keep all rows BELOW y 70% free from supernatural glow, glitter and transparency. Keep lower bodies and tails visible and opaque in their original places.
DO NOT repaint or reposition the rest of the room. Preserve the overall painterly storybook art, the cool storm palette and dim fire. No sunlight or dawn, no added captions, text, labels, UI, watermark or borders.
